description: Cancel a SINGLE session booking (not a recurring series). By default: NO refund, NOT treated as a late cancellation (no penalty), and the member IS notified. Set refund=true only to return the member's payment or credit; isLateCancellation=true applies the studio's late-cancel policy. Not undoable except by re-booking. Momence: DELETE /api/v2/host/session-bookings/{bookingId}.

disableNotifications.description: Suppress the cancellation notification to the member (default false).

isLateCancellation.description: Treat as a late cancellation under the studio policy (default false).

refund.description: Refund the member's payment/credit for this booking (default false).

name: momence_cancel_session_booking
title: Cancel one session booking
